Bio:
Jamie B, or J.B., is the infamous rapper who’s extremely ghetto and a total gangsta. She was born, grew up, and lived in the hood for her whole life. When she was born, she was dropped off somewhere in the streets by her own parents, so she was luckily raised by the guardians, although they're very ghetto and also part of gangsters. She never attended any education, so she has street smarts, except she once attended in Public High School, although it was a poor underfunded one and she caused a lot of trouble there, but she made some friends, which are actually homies. Unfortunately, her guardians don't really teach her any common things, so there are times she did a lot of criminal activities and had committed some felonies growing up. She had been in juvie a couple of times, but she didn't learn anything about it, so she decided to keep doing a bit more crime sneakily. One thing for sure, she enjoys having money, shiny things, and hot black men. Since she’s a black girl who lived in the streets, she learned a lot of stereotypes, history about racism & America, and sometimes politics. She despised most white people, however, if there’s any white people who respects black folks like her, then she’ll be okay with it. Other times, she’s very interested in rap. She listens to a lot of hip-hop rap, since her guardians allows to play. She even wants to be a rapper herself while being a gangster one day. Of course, her guardians are too lazy to do parenting and neglect her a lot of times. However, the only things that they taught her about life is surviving through struggles and driving. Not only is she interesting to rap, but also interesting to have her own car, especially sexy ones. Of course, before she became a young adult. She took a driving education and that’s the only time where she takes that education seriously. Of course, she barely passed the driving test. Although her car is a regular one, she still wants to have a sexier one…if the only thing is that she’s rich. Even if she finds one that interests her, she may even think about stealing. Other than that, during puberty, she gets horny a lot and when she was in school, she liked to see a lot of hot men. Most of them are almost young adults, she’ll even have sex with them. She’ll watch some “content” about sexual stuff and sex. She’ll even go to the Strip Club to study how strippers get their attention. How did she get in? She faked her identity and it worked. When she flirts and does sexual stuff to those men, they’ll do a lot of sex. It worked a lot. Although, she’ll keep cheating on one another. Ironically, she’s the cheater, but hates when any man cheats on her. Now, when she became a full grown adult, she decided to live on her own in the streets and wants to have her own rapping career. Luckily, one of her homies is a producer and owns a small studio in the house, so now she finally became a rapper. Although, most of her rap music doesn’t get enough fame…at first. She kept trying to become a star and eventually, she became somewhat famous. With help from her gang, she earns some attention. However, there are lots of gangs in her area who decided to diss her because of how suck she raps. Of course, she doesn’t back down and diss them back. She dealt with a lot of beef with them and fought her rivalry. They’ll even settle in a rap battle, so she’ll show who’s the boss. Sometimes, she starts the rivalry because she enjoys belittling her victims. After all of that, she’s still infamous, but can be noticeable. Her goal in life is to become a famous and richest rapper in the world. Overall, she’s a sexy ghetto rapper, but a dangerous gangster and a total thug.
